productId.description: A unique identifier for the product

url.description: The absolute URL of the product page (must include protocol and domain, e.g., https://example.com/product)

brand.description: The brand name of the product

serialNumbers.description: Product identifiers and codes (ONLY unique product identifiers like ASIN, UPC, EAN, ISBN, SKU, GTIN. EXCLUDE model names/numbers)

type.description: Type of product identifier (e.g., ASIN, UPC, EAN, ISBN, SKU, GTIN, IMEI)

price.description: The current product price listed on the page

currency.description: Currency for the price (e.g., GBP, USD)

preDiscountPrice.description: Original price ONLY if product is currently on sale/discount. Leave null if no discount exists.

availability.description: General availability status of the product

description.description: Detailed description of the product (can include HTML formatting)

bestPossibleRating.description: The highest rating value the scale allows (e.g. 5 on a 1-5 scale). NOT the highest rating any user has given.

worstPossibleRating.description: The lowest rating value the scale allows (e.g. 1 on a 1-5 scale). NOT the lowest rating any user has given.

reviews.observation: Reviews are often contained within elements that have a `data-hook` attribute like 'review' or 'customer-review'. These elements can be `div`, `li`, or other container tags. Prioritize using the `data-hook` for selection over specific tag names or complex class combinations.

images.description: Primary product images from the seller/website only (exclude user-uploaded images, customer reviews images, and similar products images)

url.description: Absolute image URL (must include protocol and domain)

images.observation: CRITICAL: Use high-resolution images, NOT thumbnails. Look for the largest/highest quality version available

videos.description: List of videos related to the product

url.description: Absolute video URL (must include protocol and domain)

videos.observation: Video data is often not in standard `<video>` tags but embedded as JSON within `<script>` tags, used to dynamically populate the media gallery. The parser should look for script tags containing keys like 'videoUrl', 'videos', or 'mediaData', extract the JSON content using regular expressions, and parse it to find video URLs. As a fallback, check image thumbnail elements for data attributes indicating a video type (e.g., `data-type='video'`).

items.description: Each product feature. From bullet points, etc. Extract full text.

url.description: Seller's absolute website URL (must include protocol and domain)

seller.observation: Seller information can appear in multiple offer blocks (e.g., 'New', 'Used', 'Refurbished'). The parser must first identify the primary offer block, which is often marked with a class like 'active' or 'selected', or is the first in a series of offer containers. All subsequent selectors for seller details should be scoped within this primary block to avoid extracting data from secondary offers.
